title: Security Intake Response Spark & Execution Kit for Enterprise Questionnaire Fast-Track
creator: Maya Chen
description: Build a lightweight, repeatable kit that turns incoming enterprise security/compliance questionnaire requests (SOC2/ISO/HIPAA/GDPR/DPA/vendor questionnaires) into a prioritized action plan, starter customer response drafts, and an evidence bundle template. The kit should support: (1) rapid triage by customer tier and jurisdiction, (2) LLM-assisted synthesis of recommended answers and missing-evidence checklists, and (3) an execution handoff for Legal/Security/Engineering with clear SLAs. Non-goal: this ticket does not implement automated answer submission to customers or full audit-proof evidence collection — those are follow-ups.
acceptance_criteria: A triage flow exists that classifies requests by urgency, jurisdiction, and hosting mode (hosted/dedicated/private) with >90% precision on a labeled sample
LLM-assisted answer drafts generated for common questionnaire sections (data residency, encryption, access controls, logging) with a confidence/uncertainty marker
Packaged evidence templates (Confluence links + checklist) created for SOC2, GDPR, and DPA that map to engineering owners
Handoff artifact created: a one-page execution plan + assignee list + SLA (48h for high-touch enterprise, 5 business days for standard requests)
Integration points captured: Slack intake channel, Confluence template, GitHub issue pattern, and Console dashboard metric (time-to-first-draft)
Stakeholders (Legal, Security, Customer Success, Platform ENG) have reviewed and approved the prototype pack
milestones: 2026-03-05: Triage schema + label set finalized (prototype dataset of 250 requests)
2026-03-12: LLM prompt templates and uncertainty schema reviewed by Security
2026-03-18: Evidence bundles (SOC2/GDPR/DPA) mapped to owners and Confluence templates created
2026-03-22: Internal pilot with Customer Success on 6 live requests
2026-03-25: Rollout + playbook published and training for Solutions Engineers
open_questions: What SLOs do Legal and Security require before we consider answers 'review-ready' (explicit wording)?
Do we permit the LLM to generate verbatim policy text or only draft language flagged for Legal review?
Should the fast-path be available to all customers or gated by ARR/tier/config (cost & risk trade-off)?
Exact mapping between questionnaire sections and evidence artifacts — should we enforce a required evidence list for high-risk asks?
Where will audit logs for intake decisions be stored for Private deployments (Console vs customer-managed KMS/legal archive)?
notes: Design decision: prefer LLM-assisted draft + human-in-the-loop review over full automation to reduce risk and speed adoption
Trade-off: enabling fast drafts increases speed but requires Legal bandwidth; mitigation is confidence scoring and auto-suggested canned answers for low-risk items
We will surface uncertainty markers in the draft (e.g., 'verify with architecture' tags) and include a required 'owner' before any customer-facing answer is sent
Pilot constraints: start with customers in NA/EU only to limit jurisdictional variance; add APAC after pilot evaluation
Related: aligns with PM-23109 (intake classifier) — leverage its dataset and model endpoints

implementation_notes: Use existing classifier endpoints from PM-23109; add a small adapter that enriches with customer tier and hosting_mode fields.
Prompting approach: few-shot templates with uncertainty calibration; store templates in repo for traceability.
UI: simple 'Generate Draft' button in the intake console that creates a GitHub issue prefilled with draft + evidence checklist
Telemetry: emit metric 'intake.time_to_draft' and 'draft.confidence' for monitoring; add alert if time_to_draft > SLA for high-touch requests
